name: How long does it take to complete finish carpentry for an ADU?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete finish carpentry for an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for ADU finish carpentry depends on the unit's size, the scope of work, and the level of detail involved. A smaller ADU with standard finishes might take a few weeks, while a larger unit with extensive custom cabinetry and intricate trim could take longer. We typically provide a project schedule after understanding the full design plan. Factors such as material lead times for custom pieces can also affect the overall duration, so early selection of finishes is beneficial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timing depends on ADU size, work scope, and detail, ranging from weeks for standard finishes to longer for custom projects.
